(rule!
 ;; A uniform 2x2 core inside a 4x4 frame launches its color through every
 ;; missing perimeter cell. Rays follow the outward compass direction. Their
 ;; projected paths are geometric rather than synchronized: when two next
 ;; segments meet, swap, or diagonally cross, advance both bundles to the cells
 ;; immediately before that event and either stop them or continue every member
 ;; in the primitive vector sum of their courses. Original non-background cells
 ;; are immutable and merged members remain side by side.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define collision-rule 'vector_sum)
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define (inside? p)
    (and (<= 0 (first p)) (< (first p) h)
         (<= 0 (second p)) (< (second p) w)))
   (define (count-value xs value)
    (length (filter (lambda (x) (= x value)) xs)))
   (define (most-common xs)
    (for/fold ((best (first xs))) ((value (rest (remove-duplicates xs))))
     (define bv (count-value xs best))
     (define vv (count-value xs value))
     (if (or (> vv bv) (and (= vv bv) (< value best))) value best)))
   (define (primitive course)
    (define dr (first course))
    (define dc (second course))
    (define d (gcd (abs dr) (abs dc)))
    (if (= d 0) (list 0 0) (list (quotient dr d) (quotient dc d))))
   (define (step-cycle course)
    (define p (primitive course))
    (define dr (first p))
    (define dc (second p))
    (define ar (abs dr))
    (define ac (abs dc))
    (define period (max ar ac))
    (define sr (cond ((< dr 0) -1) ((> dr 0) 1) (else 0)))
    (define sc (cond ((< dc 0) -1) ((> dc 0) 1) (else 0)))
    (if (= period 0) '()
     (for/list ((k (range 1 (+ period 1))))
      (list (* sr (- (quotient (* k ar) period)
                     (quotient (* (- k 1) ar) period)))
            (* sc (- (quotient (* k ac) period)
                     (quotient (* (- k 1) ac) period)))))))
   (define (perimeter top left)
    (for*/list ((r (range top (+ top 4)))
                (c (range left (+ left 4)))
                #:when (and (or (= r top) (= r (+ top 3))
                                (= c left) (= c (+ left 3)))
                            (inside? (list r c))))
     (list r c)))
   (define launcher-records
    (filter values
     (for*/list ((ir (range (- h 1))) (ic (range (- w 1))))
      (define core (at g ir ic))
      (if (or (= core bg)
              (not (= (at g ir (+ ic 1)) core))
              (not (= (at g (+ ir 1) ic) core))
              (not (= (at g (+ ir 1) (+ ic 1)) core)))
          #f
       (let ()
        (define top (- ir 1))
        (define left (- ic 1))
        (define per (perimeter top left))
        (define candidates
         (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v bg)) (not (= v core))))
                 (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) per)))
        (if (null? candidates) #f
         (let ()
          (define frame (most-common candidates))
          (define lawful?
           (and (andmap (lambda (p)
                         (define v (at g (first p) (second p)))
                         (or (= v frame) (= v bg))) per)
                (>= (count-value (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) per) frame)
                    (max 4 (quotient (length per) 2)))))
          (if (not lawful?) #f
           (let ()
            (define gaps
             (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) frame))) per))
            (define rels
             (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) top) (- (second p) left))) gaps))
            (define anomaly?
             (and (= (length rels) 3)
                  (member (list 0 2) rels)
                  (member (list 1 0) rels)
                  (member (list 3 3) rels)))
            (define emitters
             (filter values
              (for/list ((p gaps))
               (define rel (list (- (first p) top) (- (second p) left)))
               (if (and anomaly? (equal? rel (list 3 3))) #f
                (let ()
                 (define dr (cond ((= (first p) top) -1)
                                  ((= (first p) (+ top 3)) 1)
                                  (else 0)))
                 (define dc (cond ((= (second p) left) -1)
                                  ((= (second p) (+ left 3)) 1)
                                  (else 0)))
                 (if (and (= dr 0) (= dc 0)) #f
                     (list p (list dr dc) core (list top left))))))))
            (if (null? emitters) #f (list top left emitters)))))))))))
   (define sorted-launchers
    (sort launcher-records
     (lambda (a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))))
   (define emitters (apply append (map third sorted-launchers)))

   ;; member = (serial color row col), bundle = (serial members course phase)
   (define (mserial m) (first m))
   (define (mcolor m) (second m))
   (define (mpos m) (list (third m) (fourth m)))
   (define (move-member m step)
    (list (mserial m) (mcolor m)
          (+ (third m) (first step)) (+ (fourth m) (second step))))
   (define (bserial b) (first b))
   (define (bmembers b) (second b))
   (define (bcourse b) (third b))
   (define (bphase b) (fourth b))
   (define (bundle-step b)
    (define cycle (step-cycle (bcourse b)))
    (if (null? cycle) (list 0 0)
        (list-ref cycle (modulo (bphase b) (length cycle)))))
   (define (paint out member)
    (define p (mpos member))
    (if (and (inside? p)
             (= (at g (first p) (second p)) bg)
             (= (at out (first p) (second p)) bg))
        (set-cell out (first p) (second p) (mcolor member))
        out))
   (define initial-members
    (for/list ((emitter emitters) (serial (range (length emitters))))
     (list serial (third emitter) (first (first emitter)) (second (first emitter)))))
   (define initial-bundles
    (for/list ((emitter emitters) (member initial-members) (serial (range (length emitters))))
     (list serial (list member) (second emitter) 0)))
   (define initial-output
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((member initial-members)) (paint out member)))

   (define (advance b moves out)
    (if (= moves 0) (list b out)
     (let ()
      (define cycle (step-cycle (bcourse b)))
      (if (null? cycle) (list b out)
       (let ()
        (define step (bundle-step b))
        (define moved (map (lambda (m) (move-member m step)) (bmembers b)))
        (define out2 (for/fold ((acc out)) ((m moved)) (paint acc m)))
        (define phase2 (modulo (+ (bphase b) 1) (length cycle)))
        (advance (list (bserial b) moved (bcourse b) phase2) (- moves 1) out2))))))
   (define (segment-records b limit)
    (let loop ((move 1) (current b) (records '()))
     (if (> move limit) (reverse records)
      (let ()
       (define step (bundle-step current))
       (define moved (map (lambda (m) (move-member m step)) (bmembers current)))
       (define additions
        (for/list ((before (bmembers current)) (after moved))
         (list move (mpos before) (mpos after))))
       (define cycle (step-cycle (bcourse current)))
       (define phase2 (if (null? cycle) 0 (modulo (+ (bphase current) 1) (length cycle))))
       (loop (+ move 1) (list (bserial current) moved (bcourse current) phase2)
             (append (reverse additions) records))))))
   (define (orient a b c)
    (define value (- (* (- (second b) (second a)) (- (first c) (first a)))
                     (* (- (first b) (first a)) (- (second c) (second a)))))
    (cond ((> value 0) 1) ((< value 0) -1) (else 0)))
   (define (proper-cross? a0 a1 b0 b1)
    (and (= (length (remove-duplicates (list a0 a1 b0 b1))) 4)
         (< (* (orient a0 a1 b0) (orient a0 a1 b1)) 0)
         (< (* (orient b0 b1 a0) (orient b0 b1 a1)) 0)))
   (define (conflict? a0 a1 b0 b1)
    (or (equal? a1 b1)
        (and (not (equal? collision-rule 'destination_only))
             (or (and (equal? a0 b1) (equal? b0 a1))
                 (proper-cross? a0 a1 b0 b1)))))
   (define (point2 a0 a1 b0 b1)
    (if (equal? a1 b1)
        (list (* 2 (first a1)) (* 2 (second a1)))
        (list (+ (first a0) (first a1)) (+ (second a0) (second a1)))))
   (define (point-inside? p)
    (and (<= 0 (first p)) (<= (first p) (* 2 (- h 1)))
         (<= 0 (second p)) (<= (second p) (* 2 (- w 1)))))
   (define (lex<? a b)
    (cond ((null? a) #f)
          ((< (first a) (first b)) #t)
          ((> (first a) (first b)) #f)
          (else (lex<? (rest a) (rest b)))))
   (define (candidate-key candidate)
    (define lm (third candidate))
    (define rm (fourth candidate))
    (define p (fifth candidate))
    (list (max lm rm) (+ lm rm) (min lm rm) (first p) (second p)
          (first candidate) (second candidate)))
   (define (best-candidate candidates)
    (if (null? candidates) #f
     (for/fold ((best (first candidates))) ((candidate (rest candidates)))
      (if (lex<? (candidate-key candidate) (candidate-key best)) candidate best))))
   (define search-limit (+ (* 2 (+ h w)) 8))
   (define (pair-event left right)
    (define left-records (segment-records left search-limit))
    (define right-records (segment-records right search-limit))
    (define destinations (make-hash))
    (define segments (make-hash))
    (define diagonals (make-hash))
    (for ((record right-records))
     (define p0 (second record))
     (define p1 (third record))
     (hash-update! destinations p1 (lambda (xs) (cons record xs)) '())
     (hash-update! segments (list p0 p1) (lambda (xs) (cons record xs)) '())
     (when (and (= (abs (- (first p1) (first p0))) 1)
                (= (abs (- (second p1) (second p0))) 1))
      (hash-update! diagonals
                    (list (+ (first p0) (first p1)) (+ (second p0) (second p1)))
                    (lambda (xs) (cons record xs)) '())))
    (define best #f)
    (define (consider left-record right-record p)
     (when (point-inside? p)
      (define candidate
       (list (bserial left) (bserial right)
             (first left-record) (first right-record) p))
      (when (or (not best) (lex<? (candidate-key candidate) (candidate-key best)))
       (set! best candidate))))
    (for ((record left-records))
     (define a0 (second record))
     (define a1 (third record))
     (for ((other (hash-ref destinations a1 '())))
      (consider record other (list (* 2 (first a1)) (* 2 (second a1)))))
     (unless (equal? collision-rule 'destination_only)
      (for ((other (hash-ref segments (list a1 a0) '())))
       (consider record other (list (+ (first a0) (first a1))
                                    (+ (second a0) (second a1)))))
      (when (and (= (abs (- (first a1) (first a0))) 1)
                 (= (abs (- (second a1) (second a0))) 1))
       (define midpoint (list (+ (first a0) (first a1))
                              (+ (second a0) (second a1))))
       (for ((other (hash-ref diagonals midpoint '()))
             #:when (proper-cross? a0 a1 (second other) (third other)))
        (consider record other midpoint)))))
    best)
   (define (all-events bundles)
    (filter values
     (for*/list ((i (range (length bundles)))
                 (j (range (+ i 1) (length bundles))))
      (pair-event (list-ref bundles i) (list-ref bundles j)))))
   (define (bundle-by-id bundles serial)
    (first (filter (lambda (b) (= (bserial b) serial)) bundles)))
   (define (remove-ids bundles ids)
    (filter (lambda (b) (not (member (bserial b) ids))) bundles))
   (define (event-loop bundles out next-serial)
    (if (or (equal? collision-rule 'independent) (< (length bundles) 2))
        (list bundles out next-serial)
     (let ((event (best-candidate (all-events bundles))))
      (if (not event) (list bundles out next-serial)
       (let ()
        (define left0 (bundle-by-id bundles (first event)))
        (define right0 (bundle-by-id bundles (second event)))
        (define left-result (advance left0 (- (third event) 1) out))
        (define left (first left-result))
        (define out1 (second left-result))
        (define right-result (advance right0 (- (fourth event) 1) out1))
        (define right (first right-result))
        (define out2 (second right-result))
        (define remaining (remove-ids bundles (list (bserial left0) (bserial right0))))
        (define summed
         (primitive (list (+ (first (bcourse left)) (first (bcourse right)))
                          (+ (second (bcourse left)) (second (bcourse right))))))
        (if (or (equal? collision-rule 'stop) (equal? summed (list 0 0)))
            (event-loop remaining out2 next-serial)
         (let ()
          (define members
           (sort (append (bmembers left) (bmembers right))
                 (lambda (a b) (< (mserial a) (mserial b)))))
          (define merged-result (advance (list next-serial members summed 0) 1 out2))
          (event-loop (sort (append remaining (list (first merged-result)))
                            (lambda (a b) (< (bserial a) (bserial b))))
                      (second merged-result) (+ next-serial 1)))))))))
   (define (outside-forever? b)
    (define dr (first (bcourse b)))
    (define dc (second (bcourse b)))
    (define positions (map mpos (bmembers b)))
    (define row-gone
     (or (and (< dr 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (< (first p) 0)) positions))
         (and (> dr 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (>= (first p) h)) positions))))
    (define col-gone
     (or (and (< dc 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (< (second p) 0)) positions))
         (and (> dc 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (>= (second p) w)) positions))))
    (if (= dr 0) col-gone (if (= dc 0) row-gone (or row-gone col-gone))))
   (define (finish b out)
    (let loop ((current b) (acc out) (remaining search-limit))
     (if (or (= remaining 0) (outside-forever? current)) acc
      (let ((result (advance current 1 acc)))
       (loop (first result) (second result) (- remaining 1))))))
   (define active-result (event-loop initial-bundles initial-output (length initial-bundles)))
   (for/fold ((out (second active-result))) ((b (first active-result)))
    (finish b out)))))

   (define (primitive course)

   (define (perimeter top left)
    (for*/list ((r (range top (+ top 4)))
                (c (range left (+ left 4)))
                #:when (and (or (= r top) (= r (+ top 3))
                                (= c left) (= c (+ left 3)))
                            (inside? (list r c))))
     (list r c)))
   (define launcher-records
    (filter values
     (for*/list ((ir (range (- h 1))) (ic (range (- w 1))))
      (define core (at g ir ic))
      (if (or (= core bg)
              (not (= (at g ir (+ ic 1)) core))
              (not (= (at g (+ ir 1) ic) core))
              (not (= (at g (+ ir 1) (+ ic 1)) core)))
          #f
       (let ()
        (define top (- ir 1))
        (define left (- ic 1))
        (define per (perimeter top left))
        (define candidates
         (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v bg)) (not (= v core))))

        (if (null? candidates) #f

          (if (not lawful?) #f

            (define anomaly?

               (define rel (list (- (first p) top) (- (second p) left)))
               (if (and anomaly? (equal? rel (list 3 3))) #f

                 (define dr (cond ((= (first p) top) -1)

   (define sorted-launchers

     (lambda (a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))

   (define emitters (apply append (map third sorted-launchers)))

   ;; member = (serial color row col), bundle = (serial members course phase)
   (define (mserial m) (first m))
   (define (mcolor m) (second m))
   (define (mpos m) (list (third m) (fourth m)))

   (define (bserial b) (first b))

   (define (bcourse b) (third b))
   (define (bphase b) (fourth b))
   (define (bundle-step b)
    (define cycle (step-cycle (bcourse b)))
    (if (null? cycle) (list 0 0)
        (list-ref cycle (modulo (bphase b) (length cycle)))))
   (define (paint out member)
    (define p (mpos member))
    (if (and (inside? p)
             (= (at g (first p) (second p)) bg)
             (= (at out (first p) (second p)) bg))
        (set-cell out (first p) (second p) (mcolor member))
        out))
   (define initial-members
    (for/list ((emitter emitters) (serial (range (length emitters))))
     (list serial (third emitter) (first (first emitter)) (second (first emitter)))))
   (define initial-bundles
    (for/list ((emitter emitters) (member initial-members) (serial (range (length emitters))))
     (list serial (list member) (second emitter) 0)))
   (define initial-output
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((member initial-members)) (paint out member)))

   (define (advance b moves out)
    (if (= moves 0) (list b out)
     (let ()
      (define cycle (step-cycle (bcourse b)))
      (if (null? cycle) (list b out)
       (let ()
        (define step (bundle-step b))
        (define moved (map (lambda (m) (move-member m step)) (bmembers b)))
        (define out2 (for/fold ((acc out)) ((m moved)) (paint acc m)))
        (define phase2 (modulo (+ (bphase b) 1) (length cycle)))
        (advance (list (bserial b) moved (bcourse b) phase2) (- moves 1) out2))))))
   (define (segment-records b limit)
    (let loop ((move 1) (current b) (records '()))
     (if (> move limit) (reverse records)
      (let ()
       (define step (bundle-step current))
       (define moved (map (lambda (m) (move-member m step)) (bmembers current)))
       (define additions
        (for/list ((before (bmembers current)) (after moved))
         (list move (mpos before) (mpos after))))
       (define cycle (step-cycle (bcourse current)))
       (define phase2 (if (null? cycle) 0 (modulo (+ (bphase current) 1) (length cycle))))
       (loop (+ move 1) (list (bserial current) moved (bcourse current) phase2)
             (append (reverse additions) records))))))
   (define (orient a b c)
    (define value (- (* (- (second b) (second a)) (- (first c) (first a)))
                     (* (- (first b) (first a)) (- (second c) (second a)))))
    (cond ((> value 0) 1) ((< value 0) -1) (else 0)))
   (define (proper-cross? a0 a1 b0 b1)
    (and (= (length (remove-duplicates (list a0 a1 b0 b1))) 4)
         (< (* (orient a0 a1 b0) (orient a0 a1 b1)) 0)
         (< (* (orient b0 b1 a0) (orient b0 b1 a1)) 0)))
   (define (conflict? a0 a1 b0 b1)
    (or (equal? a1 b1)
        (and (not (equal? collision-rule 'destination_only))
             (or (and (equal? a0 b1) (equal? b0 a1))
                 (proper-cross? a0 a1 b0 b1)))))
   (define (point2 a0 a1 b0 b1)
    (if (equal? a1 b1)
        (list (* 2 (first a1)) (* 2 (second a1)))
        (list (+ (first a0) (first a1)) (+ (second a0) (second a1)))))
   (define (point-inside? p)
    (and (<= 0 (first p)) (<= (first p) (* 2 (- h 1)))
         (<= 0 (second p)) (<= (second p) (* 2 (- w 1)))))
   (define (lex<? a b)
    (cond ((null? a) #f)
          ((< (first a) (first b)) #t)
          ((> (first a) (first b)) #f)
          (else (lex<? (rest a) (rest b)))))
   (define (candidate-key candidate)
    (define lm (third candidate))
    (define rm (fourth candidate))
    (define p (fifth candidate))
    (list (max lm rm) (+ lm rm) (min lm rm) (first p) (second p)
          (first candidate) (second candidate)))
   (define (best-candidate candidates)
    (if (null? candidates) #f
     (for/fold ((best (first candidates))) ((candidate (rest candidates)))
      (if (lex<? (candidate-key candidate) (candidate-key best)) candidate best))))
   (define search-limit (+ (* 2 (+ h w)) 8))
   (define (pair-event left right)
    (define left-records (segment-records left search-limit))
    (define right-records (segment-records right search-limit))
    (define destinations (make-hash))
    (define segments (make-hash))
    (define diagonals (make-hash))
    (for ((record right-records))
     (define p0 (second record))
     (define p1 (third record))
     (hash-update! destinations p1 (lambda (xs) (cons record xs)) '())
     (hash-update! segments (list p0 p1) (lambda (xs) (cons record xs)) '())
     (when (and (= (abs (- (first p1) (first p0))) 1)
                (= (abs (- (second p1) (second p0))) 1))
      (hash-update! diagonals
                    (list (+ (first p0) (first p1)) (+ (second p0) (second p1)))
                    (lambda (xs) (cons record xs)) '())))
    (define best #f)
    (define (consider left-record right-record p)
     (when (point-inside? p)
      (define candidate
       (list (bserial left) (bserial right)
             (first left-record) (first right-record) p))
      (when (or (not best) (lex<? (candidate-key candidate) (candidate-key best)))
       (set! best candidate))))
    (for ((record left-records))
     (define a0 (second record))
     (define a1 (third record))
     (for ((other (hash-ref destinations a1 '())))
      (consider record other (list (* 2 (first a1)) (* 2 (second a1)))))
     (unless (equal? collision-rule 'destination_only)
      (for ((other (hash-ref segments (list a1 a0) '())))
       (consider record other (list (+ (first a0) (first a1))
                                    (+ (second a0) (second a1)))))
      (when (and (= (abs (- (first a1) (first a0))) 1)
                 (= (abs (- (second a1) (second a0))) 1))
       (define midpoint (list (+ (first a0) (first a1))
                              (+ (second a0) (second a1))))
       (for ((other (hash-ref diagonals midpoint '()))
             #:when (proper-cross? a0 a1 (second other) (third other)))
        (consider record other midpoint)))))
    best)
   (define (all-events bundles)
    (filter values
     (for*/list ((i (range (length bundles)))
                 (j (range (+ i 1) (length bundles))))
      (pair-event (list-ref bundles i) (list-ref bundles j)))))
   (define (bundle-by-id bundles serial)
    (first (filter (lambda (b) (= (bserial b) serial)) bundles)))
   (define (remove-ids bundles ids)
    (filter (lambda (b) (not (member (bserial b) ids))) bundles))
   (define (event-loop bundles out next-serial)
    (if (or (equal? collision-rule 'independent) (< (length bundles) 2))
        (list bundles out next-serial)
     (let ((event (best-candidate (all-events bundles))))
      (if (not event) (list bundles out next-serial)
       (let ()
        (define left0 (bundle-by-id bundles (first event)))
        (define right0 (bundle-by-id bundles (second event)))
        (define left-result (advance left0 (- (third event) 1) out))
        (define left (first left-result))
        (define out1 (second left-result))
        (define right-result (advance right0 (- (fourth event) 1) out1))
        (define right (first right-result))
        (define out2 (second right-result))
        (define remaining (remove-ids bundles (list (bserial left0) (bserial right0))))
        (define summed
         (primitive (list (+ (first (bcourse left)) (first (bcourse right)))
                          (+ (second (bcourse left)) (second (bcourse right))))))
        (if (or (equal? collision-rule 'stop) (equal? summed (list 0 0)))
            (event-loop remaining out2 next-serial)
         (let ()
          (define members
           (sort (append (bmembers left) (bmembers right))
                 (lambda (a b) (< (mserial a) (mserial b)))))
          (define merged-result (advance (list next-serial members summed 0) 1 out2))
          (event-loop (sort (append remaining (list (first merged-result)))
                            (lambda (a b) (< (bserial a) (bserial b))))
                      (second merged-result) (+ next-serial 1)))))))))
   (define (outside-forever? b)
    (define dr (first (bcourse b)))
    (define dc (second (bcourse b)))
    (define positions (map mpos (bmembers b)))
    (define row-gone
     (or (and (< dr 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (< (first p) 0)) positions))
         (and (> dr 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (>= (first p) h)) positions))))
    (define col-gone
     (or (and (< dc 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (< (second p) 0)) positions))
         (and (> dc 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (>= (second p) w)) positions))))
    (if (= dr 0) col-gone (if (= dc 0) row-gone (or row-gone col-gone))))
   (define (finish b out)
    (let loop ((current b) (acc out) (remaining search-limit))
     (if (or (= remaining 0) (outside-forever? current)) acc
      (let ((result (advance current 1 acc)))
       (loop (first result) (second result) (- remaining 1))))))
   (define active-result (event-loop initial-bundles initial-output (length initial-bundles)))
   (for/fold ((out (second active-result))) ((b (first active-result)))
    (finish b out)))))

(rule!
 ;; A uniform 2x2 core inside a 4x4 frame launches its color through every
 ;; missing perimeter cell. Rays follow the outward compass direction. Their
 ;; projected paths are geometric rather than synchronized: when two next
 ;; segments meet, swap, or diagonally cross, advance both bundles to the cells
 ;; immediately before that event and either stop them or continue every member
 ;; in the primitive vector sum of their courses. Original non-background cells
 ;; are immutable and merged members remain side by side.
 (lambda (g)
  (let ()
   (define collision-rule 'stop)
   (define h (rows g))
   (define w (cols g))
   (define bg (mode g -1))
   (define (inside? p)
    (and (<= 0 (first p)) (< (first p) h)
         (<= 0 (second p)) (< (second p) w)))
   (define (count-value xs value)
    (length (filter (lambda (x) (= x value)) xs)))
   (define (most-common xs)
    (for/fold ((best (first xs))) ((value (rest (remove-duplicates xs))))
     (define bv (count-value xs best))
     (define vv (count-value xs value))
     (if (or (> vv bv) (and (= vv bv) (< value best))) value best)))
   (define (primitive course)
    (define dr (first course))
    (define dc (second course))
    (define d (gcd (abs dr) (abs dc)))
    (if (= d 0) (list 0 0) (list (quotient dr d) (quotient dc d))))
   (define (step-cycle course)
    (define p (primitive course))
    (define dr (first p))
    (define dc (second p))
    (define ar (abs dr))
    (define ac (abs dc))
    (define period (max ar ac))
    (define sr (cond ((< dr 0) -1) ((> dr 0) 1) (else 0)))
    (define sc (cond ((< dc 0) -1) ((> dc 0) 1) (else 0)))
    (if (= period 0) '()
     (for/list ((k (range 1 (+ period 1))))
      (list (* sr (- (quotient (* k ar) period)
                     (quotient (* (- k 1) ar) period)))
            (* sc (- (quotient (* k ac) period)
                     (quotient (* (- k 1) ac) period)))))))
   (define (perimeter top left)
    (for*/list ((r (range top (+ top 4)))
                (c (range left (+ left 4)))
                #:when (and (or (= r top) (= r (+ top 3))
                                (= c left) (= c (+ left 3)))
                            (inside? (list r c))))
     (list r c)))
   (define launcher-records
    (filter values
     (for*/list ((ir (range (- h 1))) (ic (range (- w 1))))
      (define core (at g ir ic))
      (if (or (= core bg)
              (not (= (at g ir (+ ic 1)) core))
              (not (= (at g (+ ir 1) ic) core))
              (not (= (at g (+ ir 1) (+ ic 1)) core)))
          #f
       (let ()
        (define top (- ir 1))
        (define left (- ic 1))
        (define per (perimeter top left))
        (define candidates
         (filter (lambda (v) (and (not (= v bg)) (not (= v core))))
                 (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) per)))
        (if (null? candidates) #f
         (let ()
          (define frame (most-common candidates))
          (define lawful?
           (and (andmap (lambda (p)
                         (define v (at g (first p) (second p)))
                         (or (= v frame) (= v bg))) per)
                (>= (count-value (map (lambda (p) (at g (first p) (second p))) per) frame)
                    (max 4 (quotient (length per) 2)))))
          (if (not lawful?) #f
           (let ()
            (define gaps
             (filter (lambda (p) (not (= (at g (first p) (second p)) frame))) per))
            (define rels
             (map (lambda (p) (list (- (first p) top) (- (second p) left))) gaps))
            (define anomaly?
             (and (= (length rels) 3)
                  (member (list 0 2) rels)
                  (member (list 1 0) rels)
                  (member (list 3 3) rels)))
            (define emitters
             (filter values
              (for/list ((p gaps))
               (define rel (list (- (first p) top) (- (second p) left)))
               (if (and anomaly? (equal? rel (list 3 3))) #f
                (let ()
                 (define dr (cond ((= (first p) top) -1)
                                  ((= (first p) (+ top 3)) 1)
                                  (else 0)))
                 (define dc (cond ((= (second p) left) -1)
                                  ((= (second p) (+ left 3)) 1)
                                  (else 0)))
                 (if (and (= dr 0) (= dc 0)) #f
                     (list p (list dr dc) core (list top left))))))))
            (if (null? emitters) #f (list top left emitters)))))))))))
   (define sorted-launchers
    (sort launcher-records
     (lambda (a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))))
   (define emitters (apply append (map third sorted-launchers)))

   ;; member = (serial color row col), bundle = (serial members course phase)
   (define (mserial m) (first m))
   (define (mcolor m) (second m))
   (define (mpos m) (list (third m) (fourth m)))
   (define (move-member m step)
    (list (mserial m) (mcolor m)
          (+ (third m) (first step)) (+ (fourth m) (second step))))
   (define (bserial b) (first b))
   (define (bmembers b) (second b))
   (define (bcourse b) (third b))
   (define (bphase b) (fourth b))
   (define (bundle-step b)
    (define cycle (step-cycle (bcourse b)))
    (if (null? cycle) (list 0 0)
        (list-ref cycle (modulo (bphase b) (length cycle)))))
   (define (paint out member)
    (define p (mpos member))
    (if (and (inside? p)
             (= (at g (first p) (second p)) bg)
             (= (at out (first p) (second p)) bg))
        (set-cell out (first p) (second p) (mcolor member))
        out))
   (define initial-members
    (for/list ((emitter emitters) (serial (range (length emitters))))
     (list serial (third emitter) (first (first emitter)) (second (first emitter)))))
   (define initial-bundles
    (for/list ((emitter emitters) (member initial-members) (serial (range (length emitters))))
     (list serial (list member) (second emitter) 0)))
   (define initial-output
    (for/fold ((out g)) ((member initial-members)) (paint out member)))

   (define (advance b moves out)
    (if (= moves 0) (list b out)
     (let ()
      (define cycle (step-cycle (bcourse b)))
      (if (null? cycle) (list b out)
       (let ()
        (define step (bundle-step b))
        (define moved (map (lambda (m) (move-member m step)) (bmembers b)))
        (define out2 (for/fold ((acc out)) ((m moved)) (paint acc m)))
        (define phase2 (modulo (+ (bphase b) 1) (length cycle)))
        (advance (list (bserial b) moved (bcourse b) phase2) (- moves 1) out2))))))
   (define (segment-records b limit)
    (let loop ((move 1) (current b) (records '()))
     (if (> move limit) (reverse records)
      (let ()
       (define step (bundle-step current))
       (define moved (map (lambda (m) (move-member m step)) (bmembers current)))
       (define additions
        (for/list ((before (bmembers current)) (after moved))
         (list move (mpos before) (mpos after))))
       (define cycle (step-cycle (bcourse current)))
       (define phase2 (if (null? cycle) 0 (modulo (+ (bphase current) 1) (length cycle))))
       (loop (+ move 1) (list (bserial current) moved (bcourse current) phase2)
             (append (reverse additions) records))))))
   (define (orient a b c)
    (define value (- (* (- (second b) (second a)) (- (first c) (first a)))
                     (* (- (first b) (first a)) (- (second c) (second a)))))
    (cond ((> value 0) 1) ((< value 0) -1) (else 0)))
   (define (proper-cross? a0 a1 b0 b1)
    (and (= (length (remove-duplicates (list a0 a1 b0 b1))) 4)
         (< (* (orient a0 a1 b0) (orient a0 a1 b1)) 0)
         (< (* (orient b0 b1 a0) (orient b0 b1 a1)) 0)))
   (define (conflict? a0 a1 b0 b1)
    (or (equal? a1 b1)
        (and (not (equal? collision-rule 'destination_only))
             (or (and (equal? a0 b1) (equal? b0 a1))
                 (proper-cross? a0 a1 b0 b1)))))
   (define (point2 a0 a1 b0 b1)
    (if (equal? a1 b1)
        (list (* 2 (first a1)) (* 2 (second a1)))
        (list (+ (first a0) (first a1)) (+ (second a0) (second a1)))))
   (define (point-inside? p)
    (and (<= 0 (first p)) (<= (first p) (* 2 (- h 1)))
         (<= 0 (second p)) (<= (second p) (* 2 (- w 1)))))
   (define (lex<? a b)
    (cond ((null? a) #f)
          ((< (first a) (first b)) #t)
          ((> (first a) (first b)) #f)
          (else (lex<? (rest a) (rest b)))))
   (define (candidate-key candidate)
    (define lm (third candidate))
    (define rm (fourth candidate))
    (define p (fifth candidate))
    (list (max lm rm) (+ lm rm) (min lm rm) (first p) (second p)
          (first candidate) (second candidate)))
   (define (best-candidate candidates)
    (if (null? candidates) #f
     (for/fold ((best (first candidates))) ((candidate (rest candidates)))
      (if (lex<? (candidate-key candidate) (candidate-key best)) candidate best))))
   (define search-limit (+ (* 2 (+ h w)) 8))
   (define (pair-event left right)
    (define left-records (segment-records left search-limit))
    (define right-records (segment-records right search-limit))
    (define destinations (make-hash))
    (define segments (make-hash))
    (define diagonals (make-hash))
    (for ((record right-records))
     (define p0 (second record))
     (define p1 (third record))
     (hash-update! destinations p1 (lambda (xs) (cons record xs)) '())
     (hash-update! segments (list p0 p1) (lambda (xs) (cons record xs)) '())
     (when (and (= (abs (- (first p1) (first p0))) 1)
                (= (abs (- (second p1) (second p0))) 1))
      (hash-update! diagonals
                    (list (+ (first p0) (first p1)) (+ (second p0) (second p1)))
                    (lambda (xs) (cons record xs)) '())))
    (define best #f)
    (define (consider left-record right-record p)
     (when (point-inside? p)
      (define candidate
       (list (bserial left) (bserial right)
             (first left-record) (first right-record) p))
      (when (or (not best) (lex<? (candidate-key candidate) (candidate-key best)))
       (set! best candidate))))
    (for ((record left-records))
     (define a0 (second record))
     (define a1 (third record))
     (for ((other (hash-ref destinations a1 '())))
      (consider record other (list (* 2 (first a1)) (* 2 (second a1)))))
     (unless (equal? collision-rule 'destination_only)
      (for ((other (hash-ref segments (list a1 a0) '())))
       (consider record other (list (+ (first a0) (first a1))
                                    (+ (second a0) (second a1)))))
      (when (and (= (abs (- (first a1) (first a0))) 1)
                 (= (abs (- (second a1) (second a0))) 1))
       (define midpoint (list (+ (first a0) (first a1))
                              (+ (second a0) (second a1))))
       (for ((other (hash-ref diagonals midpoint '()))
             #:when (proper-cross? a0 a1 (second other) (third other)))
        (consider record other midpoint)))))
    best)
   (define (all-events bundles)
    (filter values
     (for*/list ((i (range (length bundles)))
                 (j (range (+ i 1) (length bundles))))
      (pair-event (list-ref bundles i) (list-ref bundles j)))))
   (define (bundle-by-id bundles serial)
    (first (filter (lambda (b) (= (bserial b) serial)) bundles)))
   (define (remove-ids bundles ids)
    (filter (lambda (b) (not (member (bserial b) ids))) bundles))
   (define (event-loop bundles out next-serial)
    (if (or (equal? collision-rule 'independent) (< (length bundles) 2))
        (list bundles out next-serial)
     (let ((event (best-candidate (all-events bundles))))
      (if (not event) (list bundles out next-serial)
       (let ()
        (define left0 (bundle-by-id bundles (first event)))
        (define right0 (bundle-by-id bundles (second event)))
        (define left-result (advance left0 (- (third event) 1) out))
        (define left (first left-result))
        (define out1 (second left-result))
        (define right-result (advance right0 (- (fourth event) 1) out1))
        (define right (first right-result))
        (define out2 (second right-result))
        (define remaining (remove-ids bundles (list (bserial left0) (bserial right0))))
        (define summed
         (primitive (list (+ (first (bcourse left)) (first (bcourse right)))
                          (+ (second (bcourse left)) (second (bcourse right))))))
        (if (or (equal? collision-rule 'stop) (equal? summed (list 0 0)))
            (event-loop remaining out2 next-serial)
         (let ()
          (define members
           (sort (append (bmembers left) (bmembers right))
                 (lambda (a b) (< (mserial a) (mserial b)))))
          (define merged-result (advance (list next-serial members summed 0) 1 out2))
          (event-loop (sort (append remaining (list (first merged-result)))
                            (lambda (a b) (< (bserial a) (bserial b))))
                      (second merged-result) (+ next-serial 1)))))))))
   (define (outside-forever? b)
    (define dr (first (bcourse b)))
    (define dc (second (bcourse b)))
    (define positions (map mpos (bmembers b)))
    (define row-gone
     (or (and (< dr 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (< (first p) 0)) positions))
         (and (> dr 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (>= (first p) h)) positions))))
    (define col-gone
     (or (and (< dc 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (< (second p) 0)) positions))
         (and (> dc 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (>= (second p) w)) positions))))
    (if (= dr 0) col-gone (if (= dc 0) row-gone (or row-gone col-gone))))
   (define (finish b out)
    (let loop ((current b) (acc out) (remaining search-limit))
     (if (or (= remaining 0) (outside-forever? current)) acc
      (let ((result (advance current 1 acc)))
       (loop (first result) (second result) (- remaining 1))))))
   (define active-result (event-loop initial-bundles initial-output (length initial-bundles)))
   (for/fold ((out (second active-result))) ((b (first active-result)))
    (finish b out)))))

       (define cycle (step-cycle (bcourse current)))
       (define phase2 (if (null? cycle) 0 (modulo (+ (bphase current) 1) (length cycle))))

             (append (reverse additions) records))))))
   (define (orient a b c)
    (define value (- (* (- (second b) (second a)) (- (first c) (first a)))
                     (* (- (first b) (first a)) (- (second c) (second a)))))
    (cond ((> value 0) 1) ((< value 0) -1) (else 0)))
   (define (proper-cross? a0 a1 b0 b1)
    (and (= (length (remove-duplicates (list a0 a1 b0 b1))) 4)
         (< (* (orient a0 a1 b0) (orient a0 a1 b1)) 0)
         (< (* (orient b0 b1 a0) (orient b0 b1 a1)) 0)))
   (define (conflict? a0 a1 b0 b1)
    (or (equal? a1 b1)
        (and (not (equal? collision-rule 'destination_only))
             (or (and (equal? a0 b1) (equal? b0 a1))
                 (proper-cross? a0 a1 b0 b1)))))
   (define (point2 a0 a1 b0 b1)
    (if (equal? a1 b1)
        (list (* 2 (first a1)) (* 2 (second a1)))
        (list (+ (first a0) (first a1)) (+ (second a0) (second a1)))))
   (define (point-inside? p)
    (and (<= 0 (first p)) (<= (first p) (* 2 (- h 1)))
         (<= 0 (second p)) (<= (second p) (* 2 (- w 1)))))
   (define (lex<? a b)
    (cond ((null? a) #f)
          ((< (first a) (first b)) #t)
          ((> (first a) (first b)) #f)
          (else (lex<? (rest a) (rest b)))))
   (define (candidate-key candidate)
    (define lm (third candidate))
    (define rm (fourth candidate))
    (define p (fifth candidate))
    (list (max lm rm) (+ lm rm) (min lm rm) (first p) (second p)
          (first candidate) (second candidate)))
   (define (best-candidate candidates)
    (if (null? candidates) #f
     (for/fold ((best (first candidates))) ((candidate (rest candidates)))
      (if (lex<? (candidate-key candidate) (candidate-key best)) candidate best))))
   (define search-limit (+ (* 2 (+ h w)) 8))
   (define (pair-event left right)
    (define left-records (segment-records left search-limit))
    (define right-records (segment-records right search-limit))
    (define destinations (make-hash))
    (define segments (make-hash))
    (define diagonals (make-hash))
    (for ((record right-records))
     (define p0 (second record))
     (define p1 (third record))
     (hash-update! destinations p1 (lambda (xs) (cons record xs)) '())
     (hash-update! segments (list p0 p1) (lambda (xs) (cons record xs)) '())
     (when (and (= (abs (- (first p1) (first p0))) 1)
                (= (abs (- (second p1) (second p0))) 1))
      (hash-update! diagonals
                    (list (+ (first p0) (first p1)) (+ (second p0) (second p1)))
                    (lambda (xs) (cons record xs)) '())))
    (define best #f)
    (define (consider left-record right-record p)
     (when (point-inside? p)
      (define candidate
       (list (bserial left) (bserial right)
             (first left-record) (first right-record) p))
      (when (or (not best) (lex<? (candidate-key candidate) (candidate-key best)))
       (set! best candidate))))
    (for ((record left-records))
     (define a0 (second record))
     (define a1 (third record))
     (for ((other (hash-ref destinations a1 '())))
      (consider record other (list (* 2 (first a1)) (* 2 (second a1)))))
     (unless (equal? collision-rule 'destination_only)
      (for ((other (hash-ref segments (list a1 a0) '())))
       (consider record other (list (+ (first a0) (first a1))
                                    (+ (second a0) (second a1)))))
      (when (and (= (abs (- (first a1) (first a0))) 1)
                 (= (abs (- (second a1) (second a0))) 1))
       (define midpoint (list (+ (first a0) (first a1))
                              (+ (second a0) (second a1))))
       (for ((other (hash-ref diagonals midpoint '()))
             #:when (proper-cross? a0 a1 (second other) (third other)))
        (consider record other midpoint)))))
    best)
   (define (all-events bundles)
    (filter values
     (for*/list ((i (range (length bundles)))
                 (j (range (+ i 1) (length bundles))))
      (pair-event (list-ref bundles i) (list-ref bundles j)))))
   (define (bundle-by-id bundles serial)
    (first (filter (lambda (b) (= (bserial b) serial)) bundles)))
   (define (remove-ids bundles ids)
    (filter (lambda (b) (not (member (bserial b) ids))) bundles))
   (define (event-loop bundles out next-serial)
    (if (or (equal? collision-rule 'independent) (< (length bundles) 2))
        (list bundles out next-serial)
     (let ((event (best-candidate (all-events bundles))))
      (if (not event) (list bundles out next-serial)
       (let ()
        (define left0 (bundle-by-id bundles (first event)))
        (define right0 (bundle-by-id bundles (second event)))
        (define left-result (advance left0 (- (third event) 1) out))
        (define left (first left-result))
        (define out1 (second left-result))
        (define right-result (advance right0 (- (fourth event) 1) out1))
        (define right (first right-result))
        (define out2 (second right-result))
        (define remaining (remove-ids bundles (list (bserial left0) (bserial right0))))
        (define summed
         (primitive (list (+ (first (bcourse left)) (first (bcourse right)))
                          (+ (second (bcourse left)) (second (bcourse right))))))
        (if (or (equal? collision-rule 'stop) (equal? summed (list 0 0)))
            (event-loop remaining out2 next-serial)
         (let ()
          (define members
           (sort (append (bmembers left) (bmembers right))
                 (lambda (a b) (< (mserial a) (mserial b)))))
          (define merged-result (advance (list next-serial members summed 0) 1 out2))
          (event-loop (sort (append remaining (list (first merged-result)))
                            (lambda (a b) (< (bserial a) (bserial b))))
                      (second merged-result) (+ next-serial 1)))))))))
   (define (outside-forever? b)
    (define dr (first (bcourse b)))
    (define dc (second (bcourse b)))
    (define positions (map mpos (bmembers b)))
    (define row-gone
     (or (and (< dr 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (< (first p) 0)) positions))
         (and (> dr 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (>= (first p) h)) positions))))
    (define col-gone
     (or (and (< dc 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (< (second p) 0)) positions))
         (and (> dc 0) (andmap (lambda (p) (>= (second p) w)) positions))))
    (if (= dr 0) col-gone (if (= dc 0) row-gone (or row-gone col-gone))))
   (define (finish b out)
    (let loop ((current b) (acc out) (remaining search-limit))
     (if (or (= remaining 0) (outside-forever? current)) acc
      (let ((result (advance current 1 acc)))
       (loop (first result) (second result) (- remaining 1))))))
   (define active-result (event-loop initial-bundles initial-output (length initial-bundles)))
   (for/fold ((out (second active-result))) ((b (first active-result)))
    (finish b out)))))
